_comment: Per-state energy office agency names and URLs. Sourced from the NASEO (National Association of State Energy Officials) directory at https://www.naseo.org/state-energy-offices. Every entry was fetched directly from the per-state NASEO page (https://www.naseo.org/state?State=<ABBR>) on 2026-04-21. URLs were then verified via HTTP probe. Redirect targets replace original URLs where the final destination differs. Three URLs (GA, MS, OH) required substitution because the NASEO-listed path returned 404 at verification time; see _notes below for each substitution.

dsire.label: DSIRE (NC State University Clean Energy Technology Center)

_notes.GA: NASEO listed https://www.gefa.georgia.gov/energy-resources (404 at verification). Substituted the verified-live GEFA domain root.
_notes.MS: NASEO listed https://mississippi.org/community-resources/office-energy/ (404). WebFetch research found the current path is /community-resources/office-of-energy/ (note the added 'of-'); substituted and verified live.
_notes.OH: User spot-check on 2026-04-21 confirmed https://development.ohio.gov returns a Page Not Found error page in a real browser. Further Playwright probing: every ohio.gov, development.ohio.gov, energy.ohio.gov, puco.ohio.gov, occ.ohio.gov, and ofcc.ohio.gov path returned either 404 or connection timeouts -- Ohio's state web infrastructure is broadly non-functional. Also tried energy.gov/cmei/scep/about-state-energy-program and energy.gov/save/home-energy-rebates -- both 404. Landed on https://www.energy.gov/ (DOE homepage) as the stable fallback since DOE is the federal umbrella for state energy programs and is verified live from multiple independent Playwright sessions. Name simplified to 'U.S. Department of Energy' since the link target is now the DOE home, not a state-level resource.
